title: File:Rohbach WWI memoirs bookletB page10-11.jpg
desc: Digitized page (own scan) from the autobiographical World War I memoirs of my maternal great-grandfather Hans Rohbach, official name Johann Baptist Rohbach (1880–1925). He wrote the manuscript in the winter of 1918–1919, shortly after returning from military service.
